about_the_game:
Game Background

This is the prosperous Chang'an in the heyday of the Tang Dynasty. The brothel is a place where talented men and beautiful women, as well as power and intrigue intertwine.

You are a mysterious passer-by in the brothel. Through wisdom and strategy, you can uncover the secrets of various characters in the brothel and experience a lingering interactive story. The game is based on ancient style, integrating poetry and desire, leading players to immerse themselves in the ancient night banquet of luxury and decadence~

Main gameplay

This is a casual card flipping game. Players flip cards in a beautiful card matrix. Each card has a corresponding suit and point. Players need to eliminate them by matching suits or points. After successfully passing the level, you can unlock a beautiful and hot CG~

Game Features

Charming courtesans, pure but scheming maids, bohemian dancers, and hidden nobles. Each character has a unique story line and CG content, with different personalities and interactive styles.

The CG plot shows the sex scenes unreservedly, including the ancient Chinese style, and the ultimate sense of substitution

The interactive mode allows players to customize the scene details and choose the character's clothing (semi-transparent gauze or naked)
